patterns.note: Prominent full-width hero section with large, bold typography and a split visual design (image on left, text/CTA on right).
Grid-based product and category displays with consistent spacing, often featuring lifestyle photography of products in use.
A muted, earthy color palette for backgrounds (greens, off-whites, dark blues) contrasted with a dark primary text color and bright, warm accents for calls to action.
The top promotional banner slides out of view on scroll, while the main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining site navigation.
A dedicated 'impact' section prominently displays the brand's social mission ('200 Million+ Donations') with large numbers and a clear call to action, reinforcing brand values.

technique_notes: The header system uses a dynamic sticky effect where a top promotional banner disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar then fixes to the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to navigation. This uses css-keyframes for the transition.
Content sections utilize full-width layouts with alternating background colors to visually separate different content blocks, creating clear visual breaks as the user scrolls.
Product and category listings are presented in responsive grid layouts, ensuring consistent item sizing and spacing across various screen dimensions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, slightly condensed sans-serif headings (hero ~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, and product images feature slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (sections have generous vertical padding, product grids are well-spaced, creating a comfortable visual density).

standout: The site effectively integrates its social mission ('one purchased = one donated') into the core design, making it a prominent and visually impactful element rather than an afterthought. The use of real, diverse models showcasing products on legs/feet adds a unique, authentic, and relatable touch, enhancing product appeal.
